english.title: Fail to evacuate / remain in a building at Southampton Airport instructed to do so by a PC / airport official / company
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse failed to

(A)_[evacuate]_
(B)_[remain in]_

a building, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BUILDING..), at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport in an emergency when instructed to do so by a constable, an airport official or the Airport Company
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(26) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
